basics.name: Yu Zhang
basics.label: PhD Researcher in Chemical and Process Engineering
basics.summary: PhD researcher developing AI-enabled, uncertainty-aware and increasingly autonomous methods for dermal formulation design, experimental decision-making and scientific data engineering.

work.name: University of Surrey
work.summary: AI-enabled formulation design and experimental decision-making for dermal drug delivery.
highlights: Develop probabilistic surrogate models, active-learning strategies and early-stopping algorithms for IVRT and IVPT experiments.
Build interpretable dynamic models using domain-knowledge-constrained symbolic regression.
Develop reproducible scientific LLM workflows for evidence extraction and dataset construction.

work.name: University of Surrey
work.summary: Teaching support across engineering systems, science principles and advanced pharmaceutical formulations.

work.name: National Key R&D Programme of China project
work.position: Lead Researcher - Fault Diagnosis and Intelligent Early Warning
work.summary: Data-driven fault diagnosis for underwater production systems.
highlights: Led development of intelligent early-warning algorithms in Python.
Identified pump failures from operational process data.

work.name: Industrial data analytics projects
work.summary: Applied process-data analytics to reservoir simulation and energy-market intelligence.
highlights: Characterised dominant flow fields from numerical reservoir simulations using clustering and data-driven analysis.
Built web-scraping and visual analytics components for a shale-gas trading market intelligence system.
